name: Investigator Dhar Master
body:
Vanara society is not warlike, nor does it have any armies. However, this peaceful tendency is not echoed by their neighbors.

When vanara settlements are attacked, they prefer to battle the opposition using guerrilla warfare. These guerrillas are often commanded by a dhar master, who use a combination of terrain knowledge, unconventional tactics and akashic backing to repell invaders. While common among the vanara, dhar masters can spring from any other societies.

Designer’s Note: Given that dhar master forgoes all alchemical abilities in exchange for akashic magic, they present as being more akin to being a hybrid of the Rogue and Eclipse classes.

Class Skills

A dhar master removes Appraise, and Knowledge (all) from their class skill list, and adds Handle Animal, Knowledge (local), Knowledge (nature), Survival, and Swim to their list.

Essence Pool (Su)

Starting at 1st level, a dhar master gains access to a pool of essence, gaining one point of essence at each level except 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th.

Veilweaving (Su)

At 1st level, a dhar master learns to shape the magical power known as akasha into powerful veils, which are drawn from the eclipse veil list. They know and can shape any veil from that list. The dhar master uses their Wisdom as their veilweaving modifier, and has a veilweaving level equal to their class level. The saving throw DCs of their veils are equal to 10 + the essence invested in the veil + their veilweaving modifier. The dhar master can only shape a limited number of veils per day. They can shape 1 veil at 1st level, and gain the ability to shape 1 additional veil each day at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th levels. Shaping veils gained from their dhar master levels requires 1 hour of meditation and quiet contemplation. This ability replaces alchemy.

Darkweaving

As the retold eclipse ability of the same name, except their essence capacity for any veils added to their list via this ability is reduced by 1(minimum 0).

Chakra Binds

At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, a dhar master gains the ability to bind veils directly to their chakras, unlocking potent new abilities. Dhar masters gain the ability to bind slots in the following order: Feet, Hands, Head, Wrists, Shoulders, and Belt.

Improved Essence Capacity

The dhar master’s continued use of their veils has improved their ability to invest them with essence. At 8th and 14th levels, the maximum essence capacity of all of their essence receptacles increases by 1.

Master’s Cunning (Ex)

A dhar master’s insight comes from a combination of battlefield knowledge, practice and exposure to the plane of memory.

At 1st level, a dhar master gains the ability to augment skill checks and ability checks through this guileful cunning. The dhar master has a cunning pool equal to 1/2 their investigator level + their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). A dhar master’s cunning pool refreshes each day, typically after they get a restful night’s sleep. As a free action, they can expend one use of cunning from their pool to add 1d6 to the result of that check, including any on which they take 10 or 20. This choice is made after the check is rolled and before the results are revealed. A dhar master can only use cunning once per check or roll. The dhar master can use cunning on any Handle Animal, Knowledge (local or nature), or Survival skill checks without expending a use of cunning, provided they’re trained in the skill.

Cunning can also be used on attack rolls and saving throws, at the cost of expending two uses of cunning each time from the dhar master’s pool. In the case of saving throws, using cunning is an immediate action rather than a free action. This ability replaces, and counts as, Inspiration.

No Trace (Ex)

At 3rd level, a dhar master learns to cover their tracks, remain hidden, and conceal their presence. The DC to track a dhar master using the Survival skill increases by +1. In addition, their training gives them a +1 insight bonus on Disguise skill checks and on opposed Stealth checks whenever they are stationary and do not take any action for at least 1 round. Every three levels thereafter, the increase to Survival DCs and the bonuses on Disguise and opposed Stealth checks increase by 1. This ability replaces poison resistance and immunity.

Insightful Combat (Ex)

Dhar masters use instinct and awareness to take advantage of opponents. Their studied combat class feature lasts for a number of rounds equal to their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), or after using studied strike, whichever comes first. This ability alters studied combat.

Trapsmith (Ex or Su)

At 5th level, a dhar master gains Learn Ranger Trap as a bonus feat even if they do not meet the prerequisites.

Essence can be bound to this ability. For each point of essence bound to this ability, a dhar master gains the knowledge of an additional ranger trap, which can be a magical one. Whenever they reassign essence, dhar masters can choose different traps. A dhar master can use ranger traps a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier plus the number of essence bound to this ability, and the DC of their traps is 10 + number of essence bound to this ability + their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces poison lore, keen recollection, and swift alchemy.

Deadly Study (Ex)

At 20th level, the dhar master knows just how to hit where it hurts. They increase the bonus from studied combat by 4, and their studied strike damage increases by 3d6. This ability replaces true inspiration.

Dhar Master Investigator Talents

The following investigator talents are available to a dhar master.

Beshadowed Guerilla Arts (Ex)

You gain a metaveil feat that you meet the prerequisites for from the following list as a bonus feat:

Disruptive Veil, Sickening Veil, Stagnating Veil, Tenebrous Veil, Shadow Grasp, Umbral Veil. This talent can be selected more than once, granting a different metaveil feat each time it is taken.

Asura of Shadows (Su)

The dhar masters are often feared by their enemies, so much so that some of the most effective of their kind are thought to be literal demons born of the darkness itself; unfortunately the line between truth and reality can be paper thin. The dhar master gains enigmas as the retold eclipse ability, using their investigator level as their effective eclipse level, and their Wisdom modifier in place of their Intelligence modifier to determine the DCs and effects of any enigmas they gain. When they first gain this talent the dhar master gains an enigma from the retold eclipse list that they meet the prerequisites for. This talent can be selected multiple times; each time grants a new enigma that they meet the prerequisites for.

The dhar master does not gain additional enigmas due to their effective eclipse level.

Shadow Clarity (Su)

As long as the dhar master has a veil with the darkness or shadow descriptor shaped they gain darkvision out to 60 feet; if they already have darkvision, it increases by 30 feet. If they have at least 5 points of essence invested in a single such veil, the dhar master gains the See In Darkness ability.

Advanced Talents

A dhar master of10th level or higher can select the following talent.

Darkness Binds (Ex)

The dhar master gains the ability to bind veils with the Darkness or Shadow descriptors to the Blood, Interface, Storm, Ring, or Voice slots.
